description: Verify that DUT TCP emits at least one ACK per two full-sized segments in a stream (RFC 1122 §4.2.3.2 p96 stretchACK floor)
approach:
[Objective]
The stretch-ACK floor: even with delayed-ACK, DUT must ACK at least every other full-sized segment. For 10 segments, ≥ 5 ACKs are required.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester ⇄ DUT: handshake.
2. Tester → DUT: 10 consecutive full-sized data segments.
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: at least 5 ACKs.

[Pass condition]
≥ 5 ACKs observed.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_no_handshake_ack — handshake never completed
• Fail_insufficient_dut_acks — fewer than 5 ACKs

verdicts.Pass: DUT emitted ≥ 5 ACKs per 10 full segments — normal
verdicts.Fail_insufficient_dut_acks: DUT emitted fewer than 5 ACKs for 10 full-sized segments
